history.summary: IDENTITY CONFIRMED: a Meerut travel portal lists 'Surajkund Temple' as one of the oldest temples in Meerut, noting that the Shahpir Mausoleum stands within its premises and that it is also called Baba Manohar Lal Mahadev Mandir. A local directory lists the same shrine as 'Baba Manohar Nath Mandir' (Baba Manohar Nath Trust, Suraj Kund Rd, Meerut; 28.97489N 77.721069E; open 4 AM-10 PM daily; rated 4.2 from 29 reviews) - a name variant; verify which name the CSV intends. No founding date, builder, or detailed history is published for this temple - verify locally. Suraj Kund itself is a historic tank/park locality of Meerut.

name: Surajkund Temple (Baba Manohar Lal Mahadev Mandir)
town_description: Meerut, in western Uttar Pradesh about 70 km northeast of Delhi, is one of the NCR's largest cities - known as the 'Sports City of India' for its sports-goods industry - and is historically famous as the city where the 1857 uprising began. Suraj Kund is a historic locality in the city, known for its old tank, park and temple cluster.

travel.airport: Nearest major airport: Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi (~70-90 km)
travel.railway: Meerut City Junction is the nearest major station (~2-3 km from most city temples); the city has seven railway stations
travel.road: On Suraj Kund Road, Meerut; city buses, auto-rickshaws and taxis available

visitor_information.opening_hours: 4:00 AM - 10:00 PM daily (per the Instagram place listing for Baba Manohar Nath Mandir - verify)
